actions.reason: Cache parsed model contents in Tokenizer.load keyed by tokenizer type and file text, and restore copies of the parsed dictionaries and vocabulary on repeated loads. This avoids reparsing and rebuilding identical model files while preserving independent mutable tokenizer state.
